0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Trepidation is writ plain on Lad Kenn's face.

26.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, enter “Lad Kenn” to call out to the pixie.

48.original: No, this is not the time for tears. If we hurry, we might still prevent the unthinkable from coming to pass.

49.original: You see, the marble─it was Kenn Gyuf's treasure, and Uin Hagan had always wanted one like it.

50.original: Now, Uin Hagan went to collect the marble near the lake, yes? I will give chase and try to find them.

51.original: Meanwhile, I need you to return to Phisor Lran to see if there's any change with the beaver. Afterwards, let us meet at the stables yonder.

53.original: It seems to be saying, “I love milk. Thank you.”

55.original: It seems to be saying, “The marble is pretty. Thank you.”

56.original: <sigh> Try as I might, I couldn't find Uin Hagan. What of the beaver?

57.original: What!? Uin Hagan too!? It's my fault! It's all my fault! <sob>

58.original: ...No, it's the <hex:021A020203>beaver<hex:021A020103> that's to blame! It's all that accursed creature's doing! Grrr, I'm going to teach it a lesson it'll never forget!

59.original: Lad Kenn flies off in the direction of Phisor Lran. You can't help but have a bad feeling about this...

61.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “Lad Kenn” to call out to the enraged pixie.

63.original: It seems to be saying, “I found my friends. Thank you. Seek out Nee Ys─they will give you a reward in my stead.”

65.original: It continues, “If Nee Ys proves uncooperative, however, tell them I've hidden my lovely pair of shoes inside the roof.”

67.original: It seems to be saying, “I love milk. Thank you.”

69.original: It seems to be saying, “The marble is pretty. Thank you.”

71.original: It seems to be saying, “I found my friends. Thank you. Seek out Nee Ys─they will give you a reward in my stead.”

73.original: It continues, “If Nee Ys proves uncooperative, however, tell them I've hidden my lovely pair of shoes inside the roof.”

74.original: Hm? You want to play, do you?

75.original: ...Is that so? Well, it's got naught to do with me. I don't owe you anything.

76.original: If you want a reward, you must play with me first. It's only fair. Let's see, now... Yes, a couple of years ought to do it.

77.original: ...Truly!? Oh, those shoes are the loveliest! When Lad Kenn flaunted them, it made me so jealous! Ah, to think that they'll be mine now!

78.original: Here's a little something by way of thanks! With that, I'm off to collect my shoes! Tee hee!
